fields.Name: T60 - Entity Form Edit Product
fields.Description: Verifies that an existing Product record can be edited and the change saved through the entity form, confirming the update-and-save path works for the Products entity.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer, open the 'Products' entity, click a product row, and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full product form. Modify an editable field such as Retail Price or Age Months, then click Save. Reach the state where the change is saved (a save confirmation appears or the new value is persisted in the form). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads and saves to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The full product form is open and an editable field such as Retail Price or Age Months was changed to a new value
A save was performed and a save confirmation or the persisted new value is visible
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
